context: Security audit of is_self_endpoint in core/src/transport/swarm.rs. Function extracted from recent changes (last 7 days).

claims.text: Wildcard bind (unspecified IP) claims all IPv6 candidates unconditionally, including public IPv6 relays on same port
Port-only matching before IP comparison allows cross-interface false positives when multiple local interfaces share a port
No validation that the candidate address is actually reachable via the matched local interface
Exact IP+port match correctly identifies self endpoints
